summary: Frontend-only testing completed for OrderNest POS UI/UX overhaul and mobile scrolling fixes. All requested features verified: (1) Mobile scrolling fixed on Quick POS and Create Order pages - both pages now scroll properly on 375x812 viewport, (2) Clean black/white theme applied throughout - login page has black left panel and black sign-in button, dashboard has black stat cards and black 'Create New Order' button, category pills are black when active, Add to Cart buttons are black, sidebar has black logo icon and black active states, KDS has black filter pills. No teal/amber colors visible in main UI elements.
